module: Mechanics controller (type "auxiliary") that distributes the length of a "sensor" beam over several "segment" beams: every frame, each segment receives the sensor length divided by the number of segments, multiplied by a factor. Used to build telescopic elements or chains of segments whose total length follows a sensor.
notes: jbeam keys (default): segmentBeamTag (required, tag of the segments), sensorBeamTag (required, the first beam found serves as the sensor), sensorBeamLengthMultiplier (1, set the number of parallel spans).
If there is no segment or no sensor, an error is logged and the controller stays inactive.
Inconsistency: beamBroken sets isActiveCoef to 0 but updateGFX never checks it, so nothing stops when a beam breaks.

updateGFX.desc: Defined at init if the configuration is valid.

init.desc: Finds the segment and sensor beams by tag.

updateGFX.desc: Sets the length of each segment from that of the sensor.

beamBroken.desc: Hook: called when a beam breaks; marks the controller inactive if it is a segment or the sensor (see notes).
